description: This file defines a Next.js page component for displaying detailed information about a recipe, using static generation methods, fetching data via API calls, and rendering UI components with recipe data including images, metadata, ingredients, and steps.

methods.name: generateStaticParams
methods.description: Generates static parameters for Next.js to pre-render recipe detail pages at build time using mock data.

methods.name: RecipeDetailPage
methods.description: Main React component that fetches recipe data by id, and renders the recipe details or an empty state if not found.
